closest_known_result.statement: Carlson's original theorem (reproduced text, original pp. 2-3) gives the rational-or-unit-circle-natural-boundary dichotomy for an integer-coefficient series regular in the unit disk. Banks--Luca--Shparlinski, Theorem 1 and §4.5 (pp. 3-4, 15-17), prove irrationality of the totient generating series; their combination yields the boundary conclusion.
closest_known_result.exact_delta: The packet's prior wording asserted a much finer, root-by-root mechanism: an explicit nonzero quadratic radial coefficient at every squarefree root of unity. Neither the local Lean file nor the located primary literature source supplies that formula.

primary_sources.title: Über Potenzreihen mit ganzzahligen Koeffizienten
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Downloaded reproduced note with Carlson's original article in the appendix: PDF pp. 12-14 contain the original printed pp. 1-3; the dichotomy is stated on PDF p. 14 (original printed p. 3), with the finite-singularity setup on PDF p. 13 (original printed p. 2).
primary_sources.supports: Carlson's text states that a non-rational integer-coefficient power series with only finitely many singularities in the unit disk either has an interior branch point or cannot be continued beyond the unit circle; for a series regular in the disk this yields the rational-or-unit-circle-natural-boundary dichotomy.
primary_sources.does_not_support: No totient-specific radial expansion or squarefree-root coefficient formula; the downloaded file is a modern reproduction carrying an appendix scan, not a claim of a publisher-original digital scan.

primary_sources.title: Irrationality of Power Series for Various Number Theoretic Functions
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Theorem 1, pp. 3-4, defines the irrationality-precision criterion; §4.5, pp. 15-17, treats F(X)=sum_{n>=1} phi(n)X^n and derives the stated finite bound for Delta_d(F).
primary_sources.supports: Banks--Luca--Shparlinski explicitly include the Euler totient series F(X)=Σ phi(n)X^n and prove in Theorem 1 a finite bound for Delta_d(F); their definition on p. 3 makes finiteness for every d equivalent to irrationality, and §4.5 gives the mod-3 recurrence/counting proof.
primary_sources.does_not_support: No claim about a quadratic radial coefficient at every squarefree root is used here, and the paper does not supply Carlson's natural-boundary implication.

primary_sources.title: Transcendence of generating functions whose coefficients are multiplicative
primary_sources.venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 364 (2012)
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Introduction, pp. 1-2: Theorem 1.2 records Carlson's dichotomy; the next paragraph names phi and cites Banks--Luca--Shparlinski for irrationality. The abstract and Theorem 1.5 give the broader multiplicative-series rational/transcendental classification.
primary_sources.supports: A directly inspected, published bridge locating both antecedents and their roles.
primary_sources.does_not_support: It is a secondary bridge for the totient conclusion, not proof of the packet's local radial-coefficient mechanism.
